outcome: The 0.2.0 adaptations are implemented in source and tested with synthetic inputs on the owner's macOS host: the Darwin supervisor variant (S4), the preparer route (S6), the M0 and M1 observer (S2, S3, S7, S10), the provider and probe host bindings with every provider document at /0.2.0 (S7, S8, S10), and the driver's selection rule, environment and Git binding (S8, S9). The independently frozen controls pass, the existing modules keep their phase-start results apart from D-18's stated exception, and the independent review, after D-20's fixes, returned ACCEPT_WITH_NONMANDATORY_FINDINGS. Nothing was prepared, run against Node, qualified or integrated.
